data.name: Farah
data.gender_notes: Farah is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ف-ر-ح (f-r-ḥ), 'to rejoice'. Faraḥ means 'joy, happiness'. Its root is ف-ر-ح (f-r-ḥ). A common Arabic given name. Farah is a Arabic name meaning “Joy; happiness; delight”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Farah expresses “Joy; happiness; delight”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ف-ر-ح (f-r-ḥ), 'to rejoice'. Faraḥ means 'joy, happiness'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farah total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
